concerns.text: US2 tasks (T005, T006, T016, T017) depend on artifacts produced in US1 (descriptors.csv from T003 and task_complexity.csv from T007) which are not part of the US2 block, violating the rule that tasks within a user‑story must form an independently‑shippable unit.

US3 tasks (T013, T008, T009, T014, T015, T010, T011, T012) rely on multiple artifacts generated in earlier stories (e.g., model/regressor.pt from T006, descriptors.csv from T003, labels.csv from T005, etc.) and therefore are not independently shippable as required for a user‑story group.
